glosses: okrug seat, okrug center, okrug administration (the administrative body of an okrug, or the place where it meets)

examples.en: This county is poor in natural resources.

examples.text: Вся округа скорбела о его смерти.
examples.en: The whole neighborhood mourned his death.

examples.text: Вашингтон, округ Колумбия, является столицей Соединенных Штатов Америки.
examples.en: Washington, D.C., is the capital of the United States of America.
